offer_text: City Memory Diagnostic 001 — $3,500 CAD, three weeks. We curate 12 source-linked Montreal archive records into one approved visual direction for your space or programme, including a provenance ledger, one buyer-ready concept deck, one realistic spatial application, and one revision round. Payment is 50% on approval and 50% on delivery. The fee excludes printing, framing, fabrication, installation, shipping, taxes, and third-party licensing fees; full interior-design or construction documents; custom software or production deployment; and unverified historical research or legal rights clearance. The diagnostic is a concept/curation deliverable, not a promise of physical production or rights beyond documented source evidence.
